title: Multi-Agentic AI for Fairness-Aware and Accelerated Multi-modal Large Model Inference in Real-world Mobile Edge Networks
abstract: arXiv:2602.07215v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Generative AI (GenAI) has transformed applications in natural language processing and content creation, yet centralized inference remains hindered by high latency, limited customizability, and privacy concerns. Deploying large models (LMs) in mobile edge networks emerges as a promising solution. However, it also poses new challenges, including heterogeneous multi-modal LMs with diverse resource demands and inference speeds, varied prompt/output modalities that complicate orchestration, and resource-limited infrastructure ill-suited for concurrent LM execution. In response, we propose a Multi-Agentic AI framework for latency- and fairness-aware multi-modal LM inference in mobile edge networks. Our solution includes a long-term Global Planning Agent, a short-term Prompt Scheduling Agent, and multiple on-node LM Deployment Agents, all powered by foundation language models. These agents cooperatively optimize prompt routing and LM

translated_title: 面向真实世界移动边缘网络中公平感知与加速多模态大模型推理的多智能体AI
translated_abstract: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）已经变革了自然语言处理和内容创作领域的应用，然而集中式推理仍然受到高延迟、可定制性有限和隐私问题的阻碍。在移动边缘网络中部署大模型（LM）成为一种有前景的解决方案。然而，这也带来了新的挑战，包括具有不同资源需求和推理速度的异构多模态大模型、使编排复杂化的多样化提示/输出模态，以及不适合并发大模型执行的资源受限基础设施。为此，我们提出了一个多智能体AI框架，用于移动边缘网络中兼顾延迟与公平性的多模态大模型推理。我们的解决方案包括一个长期全局规划智能体、一个短期提示调度智能体和多个节点上的大模型部署智能体，它们均由基础语言模型驱动。这些智能体协同优化提示路由与大模型（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个由全局规划、提示调度和节点部署三类智能体组成的多智能体AI框架，用于在移动边缘网络中实现兼顾公平性且加速的多模态大模型推理。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a multi-agentic AI framework consisting of a global planning agent, a prompt scheduling agent, and on-node deployment agents to achieve fairness-aware and accelerated multi-modal large model inference in mobile edge networks.
